decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with a dedicated page, it looks like a deliberate option the firm will likely keep open for another year while market feedback is still forming.
A stand-alone web presentation suggests a meaningful initial commitment, and for a large established manufacturer the cost of waiting one more year for clearer signals is likely low.
Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, commitment appears lighter, but after just one year uncertainty is still high enough to justify keeping the option alive.
Its own product page indicates active commercialization, so absent clear failure signs the firm would probably continue it to learn more before abandoning it.
